title: Tech Trends 2017: The kinetic enterprise
notes: Eighth edition ('This is our eighth Tech Trends report'). 7 trend chapters plus an 'Exponentials watch list' chapter with four exponential forces (entries 8-11). Trend chapters: Deloitte describes them as trends 'that demonstrate clear business impact in the next 18 to 24 months'; exponentials: 'In the next three to five years, expect to see business use cases emerge'. Introduction includes Deloitte's own look-back: 'in 2010 we predicted that asset intelligence ... was on the cusp of driving significant disruption. No question we were a few years premature'. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: IT unbounded
entries.quote: Over the next 18 to 24 months, we may see the next phase of IT transformation unfold—a phase focused on the way IT operates, how it collaborates with business and external partners, and how its development teams work smarter and more efficiently to deliver services.
entries.subject: IT operating model transformation

entries.label: Dark analytics
entries.quote: Leveraging these advanced tools and skill sets, over the next 18 to 24 months an increasing number of CIOs, business leaders, and data scientists will begin experimenting with “dark analytics”
entries.subject: Analytics of unstructured (dark) data

entries.label: Machine intelligence
entries.quote: The following algorithmic capabilities will likely see broader adoption in the public and private sectors as machine intelligence use cases emerge over the next 18 to 24 months
entries.subject: Machine intelligence (AI, machine learning, RPA, bots)

entries.label: Mixed reality
entries.quote: Though it may be several years before mixed reality’s ultimate end game materializes, the time to begin exploring this
entries.subject: Mixed reality (AR and VR)
entries.horizon: next 18 to 24 months (edition-level); chapter: 'several years' for the end game
entries.note: Chapter gives no 18-to-24-month sentence of its own; quote truncated at a page break in the source text.

entries.label: Inevitable architecture
entries.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, CIOs and their partners in the C-suite may find an answer to this question in a flexible architecture model whose demonstrated efficiency and effectiveness
entries.subject: Flexible IT architecture (open source, containers, cloud first)
entries.note: Quote ends mid-sentence in the extracted text.

entries.label: Everything-as-a-service
entries.quote: Everything-as-a-service (XaaS) is a strategic and operational blueprint that, within the next 18–24 months, will likely begin upending business and operational models, and redefining the fundamental goals of core modernization.
entries.subject: Everything-as-a-service (XaaS)

entries.label: Blockchain: Trust economy
entries.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, entities across the globe will likely begin exploring blockchain opportunities that involve some aspects of digital reputation.
entries.subject: Blockchain (digital identity and reputation)

entries.label: Nanotechnology: Nano-engineered materials
entries.quote: In the next three to five years, expect to see business use cases emerge and pioneering deployments accelerate around these once-futuristic technologies.
entries.subject: Nano-engineered materials
entries.note: Quote is the chapter-level sentence covering all four exponentials; the edition names this force's focus as 'Nano-engineered materials'.
